mapper.select: SELECT b.isbn AS isbn, (SELECT count(*) FROM bookmarks WHERE book_id = b.book_id) AS bookmarkCount, (SELECT count(*) FROM book_reviews WHERE book_id = b.book_id) AS reviewCount, (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM book_reviews WHERE book_id = b.book_id) AS avgRating FROM books b WHERE b.isbn IN #{isbn}
SELECT b.isbn FROM books b INNER JOIN bookmarks m ON b.book_id = m.book_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND b.isbn IN #{isbn}

SELECT (SELECT count(*) bookmarkCount FROM bookmarks WHERE book_id = #{bookId}) (SELECT count(*) reviewCount FROM book_reviews WHERE book_id = #{bookId}) (SELECT AVG(rating) avgRating FROM book_reviews WHERE book_id = #{bookId})
